n.story:
In the foundry of the near future, your role remains essential but becomes significantly more data-informed. While the physical act of repairing defects and inserting complex structures remains a human-led craft due to the tactile feedback required, the 'guesswork' of the casting process disappears. AI will take over the heavy lifting of moving filled coquilles and the precision-timed extraction of products, reducing your exposure to high-heat environments and repetitive strain.

Your primary evolution lies in becoming a master troubleshooter. When a casting fails or uniformity is off, you won't just rely on experience; you'll consult AI diagnostics that analyze thermal patterns and metal flow in real-time. You will transition from a manual operator to a technical supervisor who handles metal work orders through digital twins, ensuring that every pour meets exact specifications before the metal even hits the mould.
